notes:
Bugfixes:

- IPTV Check now caches the last successfully loaded IPTV group names and reuses them as a fallback when m3u4u is temporarily unavailable, so the Settings tab no longer collapses to One Channel only during HTTP 521/522 or timeout incidents.
- Settings keyboard/remote focus navigation is simplified so Left from controls inside an open tab returns directly to the active tab list instead of requiring multiple presses.

Important:

- No Dorcel playback, predictive restart, WiFi, PVR configuration, long-check timing, watchdog, log-copy, Save Log Only or shutdown behaviour was changed in this release.
